Container.Name: ProtonMailBridge
Container.Overview:
Proton Mail Bridge creates a local IMAP/SMTP server that decrypts your Proton Mail, allowing other containers and email clients on your network to send and receive email through your Proton account.
Includes a web-based setup UI — no command line required. After installing, open the WebUI to log in with your Proton credentials and view your IMAP/SMTP connection details.
IMPORTANT: Requires a paid Proton plan (Mail Plus, Proton Unlimited, or Proton for Business). Free accounts cannot use Bridge.
Use cases: Send notifications from apps like Nextcloud, Gitea, Home Assistant, Uptime Kuma, Paperless-ngx, or any service that supports SMTP. Receive mail via IMAP in self-hosted mail clients.

Config.Name: Config Storage
Config.Description: Persistent storage for Bridge configuration, credentials, and mail cache. Must survive container recreates.

Config.Name: SMTP Port
Config.Description: SMTP port for sending email. Point your apps here. Default: 1025

Config.Name: IMAP Port
Config.Description: IMAP port for receiving email. Default: 1143

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web interface for setup and monitoring. Default: 3080

Config.Name: WEBUI_PORT
Config.Description: Internal web UI port (do not change unless you have a conflict)

Config.Name: WEBUI_AUTH_TOKEN
Config.Description: Access token for the Web UI. Set this to require authentication when accessing the management interface. Leave empty to disable auth (not recommended).
